name: echo mona lisa
description: Proposal, culture, 60 cell lattice (8 px cells, the creature at 3x as in mushroom HD), after Leonardo's Mona Lisa (about 1503, public domain): the creature sits for it half length, the frame cutting it off under its folded hands, its box the face with the family's visor and slit eyes, long dark brown hair falling from a crown over its head to its shoulders with the antenna standing up through it, a gown in its own feet teal under a shallow ochre trimmed neckline, ochre sleeves coming in from both sides and two teal mitts folded one over the other at the bottom centre, the lower one showing beside the upper, in front of a sfumato landscape (a warm pale sky, jagged blue green mountains standing over a pale lake on each side, ochre hills, a pale road winding up on the left, a small arched bridge on the right where a river leaves the lake); it rests on the postcard, eyes on the viewer and a faint smile, then its eyes drift two cells left after someone walking past while the smile settles flat, come back to the viewer as the smile deepens, blink, drift right and back the same way, and end on a slow glint, the antenna tip lit with a four point star of ping opening and closing round it while it smiles; judge whether it reads as the Mona Lisa from a metre away, whether the faint smile still shows on the panel itself (it is soft teal on the teal face), whether the smile reads as coming and going rather than switching, whether the hair and the gown read as a costume on the creature, and whether it is still this creature.
